title: Source test: credentials in the request never appear in the response
summary: Sends two http source tests whose URL carries a password and an api_key query value and whose config carries an auth_token: one to a page that exists, one to a 404 page. Neither response may contain any of the three secret values.

steps.title: Test a reachable page with credentials
steps.explain: A passing test must not echo credentials.

steps.title: The reachable page passes
steps.explain: Credentials must not stop a valid source from passing.

steps.title: Password absent from the passing response
steps.explain: The URL password must never be returned.

steps.title: api_key value absent from the passing response
steps.explain: Query-string secrets must never be returned.

steps.title: auth_token absent from the passing response
steps.explain: The bearer token must never be returned.

steps.title: Test a 404 page with the same credentials
steps.explain: Error messages are where secrets usually leak.

steps.title: The 404 page fails
steps.explain: The test must still report the failure.

steps.title: Password absent from the failing response
steps.explain: The URL password must never be returned.

steps.title: api_key value absent from the failing response
steps.explain: Query-string secrets must never be returned.

steps.title: auth_token absent from the failing response
steps.explain: The bearer token must never be returned.
